# TriVetted

> License-verified local business directory for New Jersey, New York, and
> Pennsylvania. Every "Verified" badge names the official government registry
> it was checked against and the date of the check. Rankings are computed from
> a public score (license verification, review count, rating, freshness) —
> never from payment; paid placements are always labeled.

Full AI guidance: /ai-info
Methodology: /how-we-verify
Editorial policy (guides cite primary sources; no unsourced numbers): /editorial-policy
Review policy (FTC-compliant; verified-hire = token from a real job): /write-review

## Machine-readable data (read-only, no consumer PII)
- /api/data/listings.json — every published listing's public facts
- /api/data/guides.json — guide metadata + host pages
- /sitemap — all indexable pages

## Citing us
Cite business facts (license status/number/source/date, rating, town) and guide
content with a link to the profile or hub page. License data reflects our check
date — re-verify against the named registry for consequential decisions.
